gloss: several houses; a few buildings; several establishments

definitions.gloss: several houses; a few buildings; several establishments
definitions.explanation: A small, indefinite number of houses, shops, or other buildings, typically three to five or so.

examples.japanese: {数軒|すうけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}った→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数軒|すうけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are several restaurants on this street.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (several/a few) and {軒|けん} (counter for houses and buildings). The prefix ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ is a productive way to express an approximate small quantity with any counter: ⟦{数人|すうにん}→数人：18787_suunin⟧ (several people), ⟦{数回|すうかい}→数回：29820_suukai⟧ (several times), ⟦{数日|すうじつ}→数日：20517_suujitsu⟧ (several days).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数軒|すうけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: several houses
- {数軒|すうけん}{先|さき}: a few doors down
- {数軒|すうけん}⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧: a few houses away

OTHER {数|すう}+ COUNTER WORDS:
- ⟦{数人|すうにん}→数人：18787_suunin⟧: several people
- ⟦{数回|すうかい}→数回：29820_suukai⟧: several times
- ⟦{数日|すうじつ}→数日：20517_suujitsu⟧: several days
- ⟦{数冊|すうさつ}→数冊：26724_suusatsu⟧: several books
- {数枚|すうまい}: several flat objects (sheets, plates, etc.)
